name: Chill Vibes
description: Easy mode. Light sips, good vibes, no blank spots. Expected drinks: ~6.

spaces.label: Hammock Start
spaces.msg: {name} hits Hammock Start. Take a breath and set the vibe.

spaces.label: Good Vibes Only
spaces.msg: {name} lands on Good Vibes Only! Say one genuine compliment to each player - or take 1 sip for each player left out.

spaces.label: Golden Hour
spaces.msg: {name} lands on Golden Hour. Everyone strikes their best pose for 5 seconds.

spaces.label: Petal Path
spaces.msg: {name} lands on Petal Path. Share one thing you are grateful for.

spaces.label: Rainbow Ridge
spaces.msg: {name} lands on Rainbow Ridge. Group picks a one-word mood check from everyone.

spaces.label: Dance Off
spaces.msg: {name} triggers Dance Off! {name} busts out a 10-second dance move - if the group claps, {name} picks someone to sip. If not, {name} sips.

spaces.label: Dusk Sip
spaces.msg: {name} lands on Dusk Sip. Tell a quick fun fact about yourself.

spaces.label: Campfire Circle
spaces.msg: {name} lands on Campfire Circle. Group asks one light question.

spaces.label: Storytime
spaces.msg: {name} lands on Storytime! Share an embarrassing story (real or made up). Group votes if it's true - winners pick someone to sip.

spaces.label: Honeybee Hop
spaces.msg: {name} lands on Honeybee Hop. Buzz a short tune and pass the turn energy.

spaces.label: Starlight Sip
spaces.msg: {name} lands on Starlight Sip. Everyone points at the next player to roll.

spaces.label: Trivia Light
spaces.msg: {name} gets a Trivia Light question! The whole group writes down an answer - anyone wrong sips 1, but {name} gives out 2 sips if right.

spaces.label: Midnight Sip
spaces.msg: {name} lands on Midnight Sip. Whisper a random word and pass it on.

spaces.label: Final Stretch
spaces.msg: {name} lands on Final Stretch. Hype up the table before the finish.
